text:
The assistant provides a comprehensive and accurate overview of Japanese business etiquette. It covers all the essential "pillars" of interacting in a Japanese professional environment, including the ritual of *meishi* (business cards), the importance of punctuality, the nuances of communication (both verbal and non-verbal), and the cultural emphasis on consensus (*nemawashi*).

The response is well-structured, easy to read, and offers practical, actionable advice. It correctly identifies the importance of the honorific "-san" and the specific etiquette surrounding gift-giving and dress codes. The depth is appropriate for a general inquiry, providing enough detail to be useful without becoming overwhelming.

Rating: [[10]]
